item.address: 505/38 Cumberland Street, The Rocks NSW 2000, NSW 2000
item.description:
SIRIUS stands as a testament to Sydney's enduring allure, a landmark reimagined for the discerning few who crave luxury and exclusivity. More than a residence, the SIRIUS is a statement, a place where history and contemporary design converge to create an extraordinary living experience on the world's most captivating harbour.

Discover refined living in one of Sydney's most prestigious developments. This apartment at Sirius Sydney presents 170sqm of sophisticated internal space and a 10sqm private terrace, offering seamless indoor-outdoor living in a landmark setting.

- Three spacious bedrooms designed for comfort and privacy
- Two designer bathrooms with high-end finishes
- Secure parking for two vehicles
- Light-filled interiors with expansive views across Sydney's iconic skyline
- Positioned moments from Sydney Harbour, Circular Quay, and Barangaroo

At SIRIUS, your days are enriched by a lifestyle of unparalleled convenience and personalised attention. A dedicated 24/7 concierge service anticipates your every need, from arranging seamless transportation to securing reservations at Sydney's most sought-after restaurants. Enjoy exclusive resident amenities, including a state-of-the-art gymnasium, a tranquil spa and sauna, and elegant resident lounges, perfect for both intimate gatherings and sophisticated socialising. Life here extends beyond your residence. Living at SIRIUS means living a curated experience, where every detail is meticulously crafted to enhance your well-being and free you to savour the best of Sydney Harbour living.

This is a rare opportunity to secure an exclusive residence in The Rocks.

2025 CTBUH Awards, Best International Tall Building by Height (under 100m)
2025 Australian Institute of Architects (AIA) NSW State Awards, Residential Architecture - Multiple Housing.
